title: Break block item effect outcome
description: Attempts to break a block at the given position. The breaker field is used to determine which entity is breaking the block. The harvest condition determines if the block should drop loot.

position.$comment: The position of the block to break

breaker.$comment: The entity that should count as the breaker of the block, possibly affecting statistics, loot drops, and other effects and mods.

harvest.$comment: Set to true to cause the block to drop loot. Defaults to false.
